Finding: Strict CSV parsers (DuckDB, pandas) stop on the file: unescaped quotes in free text, stray `";"`
Treatment: Line reader splitting on `";"`, extra pieces merged back into the free-text column (`src/cordis_io.py`, tested)

Finding: Decimal comma in project amounts, decimal point in organisation amounts
Size (Horizon Europe unless stated): 13,009 project values with a comma; 52,760 organisation values with a point
Treatment: `parse_amount` accepts both; control total of the raw files = total loaded (check Q05)

Finding: Total cost = 0 for lump-sum and unit-cost grants (e.g. MSCA fellowships)
Treatment: Stored as NULL = not reported, never as a real zero

Finding: Associated partners have empty contributions; affiliated entities have 0 gross but a net amount
Size (Horizon Europe unless stated): 25,456 empty; 5,907 affiliated entities funded in the net column only
Treatment: Empty = 0 for unfunded roles; the analysis uses the **net** contribution of funded roles

Finding: Participants' net contributions do not add up to the project maximum
Treatment: Reported by check Q07, not corrected (the source is authoritative)

Finding: EU country codes instead of ISO (`EL` Greece, `UK` United Kingdom), Kosovo `XK`
Treatment: Mapped to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 with the EU country authority table
First code kept and logged; missing left NULL (check Q09)

Finding: `(projectID, order)` is not unique; `(projectID, organisationID, role)` is not unique either
Treatment: Natural key = (project, organisation, role, order): unique for all 151,382 rows; an organisation can leave and re-join (check Q14)

Finding: SME status of the same PIC changes between projects
Treatment: SME stored on `participation`, not on `organisation` (it is a fact about the participation, at that time)

Finding: Same name, several PICs (possible duplicate registrations)
Size (Horizon Europe unless stated): 42 exact names; 190 normalised name + country groups
Treatment: Reported as candidates (Q10), **not merged**: the PIC is the EU identifier
Kept, shown as '(not classified)' in every breakdown

Finding: CORDIS domain codes deeper than the published EuroSciVoc; one code without any label
Size (Horizon Europe unless stated): 103 codes not in EU Vocabularies; 1 unlabelled
Treatment: Local concept linked to its official parent; explicit 'unlabelled' label (Q18)

Finding: Grant signed after the project start date
Several legal bases in `project.legalBasis`; one project without funding scheme; projects without start date
Treatment: Main part from `legalBasis.csv` (`uniqueProgrammePart`); 'NOT_REPORTED' scheme; NULL dates

Finding: Duplicate web-link ids (within and across programmes)
Address, VAT number, coordinates and contact form link in `organization.csv`
Treatment: Dropped at staging, before any storage (tested)
